summary: plusMINT PO of 9 November 2020 (section 3 and 5): after a 30-ECTS orientation phase, the specialization follows the examination regulations of the analogous bachelor program (Maschinenbau PO of 5 July 2023). PO 2023 section 7: 113 ECTS compulsory basic phase, then in the main phase Data Science, Studienarbeit, Project III and a 15-ECTS internship, plus one specialization of six, in which 12 ECTS specific foundations, 12 ECTS basic and 18 ECTS advanced modules are chosen in an individually approved specialization plan. The checklist cannot link the two specialization rules to the same specialization and checks basic and advanced modules only as a 30 ECTS total. Main phase exams require 90 ECTS from the basic phase.
